images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A side-on cross-section of an ant colony like a warm lamp-lit terrarium diorama behind glass: layered soil strata in dark umber, red-brown loam, ochre clay and pale sand, dotted with glossy pebbles and fine roots; giant blurred grass blades above the ground line glow in warm backlight. Carved tunnels connect rounded chambers lit by tiny glowing amber resin lamps. In the large central chamber a gigantic red metal bottle cap with a fluted crimped edge lies half excavated, its right part still under a grid of soil squares marked with taut string lines and tiny red pin flags; glossy red-brown ant scholars measure it with a stick, brush dust from the grid, and carry tiny paper scrolls. Speech bubble: '뿔이 스물하나. 왕관이 틀림없소!'. A small archive chamber holds racks of tiny scrolls; the queen rests in a lower chamber. Right side: a parchment hanging scroll with wooden rods titled '학회 두루마리', an artifact card '붉은 톱니 원반', and three hypothesis cards with vote bars, the top one '하늘 거인의 왕관' marked with a red wax seal. Bottom left tool buttons '파기', '붓질'. Warm tilt-shift miniature photography look, amber lighting, soft shadows, paper grain.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same soil cross-section thirty ant generations later: a grand oval temple chamber carved in the earth, flanked by pillars made of tree roots, with ant cave-paintings of six circles on the walls. On a stepped earthen altar sits a huge glowing yellow plastic toy building brick with six round studs on top, treated as a holy relic, surrounded by golden light rays and small offerings of seeds; rows of glossy red-brown ants kneel before it and two priest ants stand at the altar sides. The chamber ceiling has just been broken open: soil chunks and dust are falling, and a large gold ring with a sparkle crashes in beside the brick while startled ants rear back. Speech bubbles: '일곱째 여왕이 내려오셨다!' and '돌기는 여섯이어야 하오. 이건 불경이오.'. A dark banner at the top reads '신전 천장이 뚫렸다'. Right side: a parchment scroll titled '여섯 돌기 경전' with three meters '신앙', '학문', '분열', a small timeline, and three choice buttons, the first highlighted '성물로 편입한다'. A taped white note in the lower left labelled '지상 기록'. Warm miniature diorama look, honey-gold and umber palette, glowing halo, paper grain.
